---
title: "Hill Functions and Toggle Switches"
---

## Core Question

How does cooperativity create switch-like behavior, and when is a small mechanistic model useful?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Define Hill activation and repression functions.
- Draw nullclines.
- Use phase-line or slope intuition for stability.
- Explain bistability as memory.
- Write two-gene toggle-switch equations.
- Sketch a phase plane.
- Explore parameter sensitivity.
- Contrast mechanistic ODEs with HMMs and matrix methods.
